AboutSubTitle.zh-CN: 能跑Lua脚本的串口调试工具

AboutDiscriptionMain.zh-CN: LLCOM-Y 是一款串口调试工具，连接可靠、断线后可自动重连，右侧带快捷发送区。
AboutDiscriptionMain.en-US: LLCOM-Y is a serial port debugging tool. It reconnects automatically after the port is lost and includes a quick-send panel.

AboutDiscriptionMore.zh-CN: 本工具除了具有与其他同类工具，所包含的数据收发功能外，还添加了Lua运行环境。用户可自行使用Lua，完成几乎所有可以想象到的自动化操作，大大提高了串口工具的可用性。
AboutDiscriptionMore.en-US: Besides basic send/receive, it embeds a Lua runtime, so you can automate almost anything you can imagine.

SerialMonitorHint.zh-CN: 提示：先点「开始监听」，再让目标程序打开串口——监听开始前已打开的串口不会被捕获。目标程序位数需与 LLCOM 一致：64 位版只能监听 64 位程序（32 位目标暂不支持）。
SerialMonitorHint.en-US: Tip: start monitoring first, then let the target app open the serial port — ports already open before monitoring starts are not captured. Target bitness must match LLCOM: the x64 build can only monitor 64-bit apps (32-bit targets are not supported yet).

SerialMonitorStartFailed.zh-CN:
监听启动失败。

常见原因：权限不足（可尝试以管理员身份运行）、被安全软件拦截，或目标进程已退出。
SerialMonitorStartFailed.en-US:
Failed to start monitoring.

Common causes: insufficient permission (try running as administrator), blocked by security software, or the target exited.

SerialMonitorInjectFailed.zh-CN:
监听启动失败：未能把监听模块注入目标进程。

常见原因：目标进程位数不一致、权限不足（可尝试以管理员身份运行），或被安全软件拦截。
SerialMonitorInjectFailed.en-US:
Failed to start monitoring: could not inject the hook into the target process.

Common causes: bitness mismatch, insufficient permission (try running as administrator), or blocked by security software.

SerialMonitorBitnessMismatch.zh-CN:
目标进程是 {0} 位程序，而当前 LLCOM 是 {1} 位版本，无法监听。

64 位版只能监听 64 位程序。32 位目标的监听暂不可用（x86 版的旧插件在部分系统上会导致目标程序崩溃），请改用 64 位目标程序。
SerialMonitorBitnessMismatch.en-US:
The target process is {0}-bit while this LLCOM is {1}-bit.

The x64 build can only monitor 64-bit apps; monitoring 32-bit targets is currently unavailable (the legacy x86 plugin can crash the target on some systems). Use a 64-bit target.

SerialMonitorLoadFailed.zh-CN:
串口监听插件加载失败：{0}

可能是被杀毒软件拦截或系统缺少运行库；可尝试以管理员身份运行。
SerialMonitorLoadFailed.en-US:
Failed to load the serial monitor plugin: {0}

It may be blocked by antivirus or a runtime is missing; try running as administrator.
